description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of six channel pairs followed by SBR payloads with a CRC-10 (EXT_SBR_DATA_CRC), the third and fifth with a wrong one: HE-AAC at 44100 Hz, four checksums verified and two failed.
findings: 2 raw data blocks hold an SBR payload whose CRC differs
6 of 6 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.decode: ffmpeg does not check the CRC and prints "No quantized data read for sbr_dequant" for the payloads after the first.
